bindings.section4:
literal:Manual checklist:
- In the LMS notification settings, set Messages and Submissions to notify right away.
- Calendar feed URL locations - Canvas: Calendar > Calendar Feed. Blackboard: Calendar > gear icon. Brightspace: Calendar > Settings > Enable Calendar Feeds > Subscribe. Moodle: Calendar > Export calendar (get URL).
- Weekly: download the gradebook CSV and run Nudge Missing (from gradebook CSV) or Review Grades and Export for a Closed LMS.
- Each term: import the generated course cartridge (LMS export step) into the LMS, and re-run this onboarding if feeds change.
- Optional: point an institutional Power Automate flow at a webhook trigger URL for instant events.
